question: Should the Claw update-planning CLI/schema land as this RFC slice after the workspace-root bug is fixed, or wait/rework until the Claws apply/doctor stack is accepted?
rationale: This PR adds a new public CLI and JSON plan contract on top of still-open Claws lifecycle work, so final landing order and contract shape need maintainer intent after the mechanical bug is fixed.

options.title: Fix Root Contract Then Continue
options.body: Require a known workspace root for newly introduced workspace/persona entries, then keep the PR in the Claws stack for normal maintainer review.

options.title: Pause Until Stack Settles
options.body: Keep the draft open but defer acceptance until the apply, workspace, and doctor PRs establish the persisted state contract.

options.title: Rework Update Surface
options.body: Replace this CLI/schema slice if maintainers want Claw update planning behind a different command, plugin, or RFC shape.

recommendation.title: Fix Root Contract Then Continue
recommendation.body: Require a known workspace root for newly introduced workspace/persona entries, then keep the PR in the Claws stack for normal maintainer review.

likelyOwner.reason: CONTRIBUTING.md identifies `steipete` as the top-level product decision owner, while this PR adds a new public Claw lifecycle surface.
